issues.description: Farm.animals collection type contradicts the specification: the problem statement/UML specifies a `List<Animal>` (implemented as an `ArrayList`), but the reference solution declares `private Queue<Animal> animals;` and initializes it with `new LinkedList<>()`. This changes the required API/semantics (e.g., `add` vs `offer`) and makes it unclear which design students should follow.
issues.suggestedFix: Align code and spec. Preferred: change the solution to `private List<Animal> animals;` initialized with `new ArrayList<>()`, update getter/setter to `List<Animal>`, and use `animals.add(a)` in `addAnimal`. Alternatively, update the UML/problem statement to require `Queue<Animal>`/`LinkedList` and adjust wording/API accordingly.
